summary: GLM-5.3 (744B) prefill with decode context parallelism runs 1.4x faster at DCP2, 1.7x at DCP3 and 2.5x at DCP6
compatibility: Opt-in: set VLLM_B12X_MLA_CKV_GATHER=1 and VLLM_DCP_INDEXER_KEY_GATHER=1 for GLM-5.2/5.3 DSA launches with decode context parallelism. DCP1, decode and GLM-5.3-Flash are unchanged.
details: Pure prefill batches gather each request's native 656-byte cache records from every DCP rank and attend their local query heads over the complete cache, instead of gathering the DCP group's queries and merging LSE-weighted partial outputs (the GLM-5.3-Flash full-CKV path, ported from joninco's dev/jovian-judgement). Batches whose summed context exceeds VLLM_B12X_MLA_CKV_GATHER_MAX_TOKENS (524,288) keep the query exchange.

The B12X DSA indexer gathers each request's index keys once per indexer layer and splits the prefill rows across the tensor-parallel ranks, which exchange only the selected indices instead of every shard's top-k candidates and scores.

Captured graphs, speculative verification, decode rows and mixed decode batches keep their existing exchanges. The gathered-cache workspace fits within the shared workspace that the model already reserves, and its selection kernels compile before serving.

A 1,015K-token prompt at DCP6 prefills in 360 s (CKV gather up to 524K context); VLLM_B12X_MLA_CKV_GATHER_MAX_TOKENS=1048576 lowers that to 329 s at 11,902 fewer KV tokens (0.9%). Needle retrieval 3/3 at 421,762 (DCP2), 662,630 (DCP3) and 1,010,918 (DCP6) tokens.
